name: softube-ts-tame-cymbals
description: Tame cymbal/hat wash via the Softube Transient Shaper: REDUCE SUSTAIN on the HIGH band only (crossover 1.5 kHz) so long cymbal/hat decays are shortened while the kick/snare body below the crossover is untouched. The inverse of overhead-shimmer. No punch, Clip off.
intended_for: an overhead/drum bus with too much cymbal/hat wash or ringy hats — control the HF tail without dulling the kit body
plugin_build: Softube 'Transient Shaper.vst3' (renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok-authorized — re-verify on a new machine)
notes: HIGH-band negative sustain shortens cymbal/hat decay; the LOW body stays full (opposite of the WIDE cut that chokes everything). Don't push past ~-4 or hats start to gate unnaturally. Expect 8-16k band DOWN, centroid down a touch; A/B loudness-matched.
